subcategory_text: Protections against data leaks are implemented.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: AC-4 (Information Flow Enforcement), SC-7 (Boundary Protection), SI-4 (System Monitoring)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.8.22, A.8.23 (Web filtering), A.8.16 (Monitoring activities)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 PR.DS-05 (data leak protections)
implementation_examples: Implement protections against data leaks using DLP (data-at-rest discovery, data-in-motion inspection, data-in-use telemetry), access control, and segmentation
Tune DLP rules against false-positive baselines
Investigate and respond to DLP alerts within defined SLAs
assessment_objectives: Determine whether leak-protection mechanisms are configured and active
Determine whether DLP rules are tuned and audited
Determine whether alerts are responded to within SLAs
Determine whether leak-protection coverage extends to third-party systems
